}}'''Balladare Arandaille''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]].

== History ==
Balladare was elected Amyrlin in {{Ne|115}}, succeeding [[Edarna Noregovna]].{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}. She is famous for the consideration that it is the moral duty of the Amyrlin to "explain herself to the common people" once she had made an important decision.

The [[Kavarthen Wars]] occurred during her tenure.{{Ref|[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]}}

She is known for this quote:

{{quote|The Amyrlin understands the most complex of creeds and debates, yet in the end, she is servant to all, even the lowest laborers.}} 

She used this to explain her reign during the Kavarthen Wars just before her death. Centuries later [[Egwene al'Vere]] quoted this line to [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]. 

Balladare is regarded as a weak Amyrlin and died in {{Ne|142}}.
